mapper.insert: INSERT INTO u_a_point_record (id, o_sec_id, account_id, `type`, points, material_id, create_time) values (NULL, #{oSecId}, #{accountId}, #{type}, #{points}, #{materialId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, o_sec_id, account_id, `type`, points, material_id, create_time FROM u_a_point_record WHERE o_sec_id=#{oSecId} ORDER BY create_time
SELECT id, o_sec_id, account_id, `type`, points, material_id, create_time FROM u_a_point_record WHERE account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY create_time

SELECT re.id, re.type, re.points, re.create_time, re.o_sec_id, re.account_id, re.material_id, sec.`name` AS sec_name, top.`name` AS top_name, u.`name` AS user_name, u.phone, m.`name` AS material_name, m.title AS material_title, m.knowledge_point AS material_knowledge_point FROM `u_a_point_record` re INNER JOIN `u_a_organization_sec` sec ON re.o_sec_id=sec.id INNER JOIN `u_a_organization_top` top ON sec.p_id=top.id INNER JOIN `u_a_account` account ON re.account_id=account.id INNER JOIN `u_a_user` u ON account.phone=u.phone INNER JOIN `materials` m ON re.material_id=m.id WHERE re.o_sec_id=#{oSecId} AND re.type='CONSUME' ORDER BY create_time DESC;

SELECT re.id, re.type, re.points, re.create_time, re.o_sec_id, re.account_id, re.material_id, sec.`name` AS secName, top.`name` AS topName FROM `u_a_point_record` re INNER JOIN `u_a_organization_sec` sec ON re.o_sec_id=sec.id INNER JOIN `u_a_organization_top` top ON sec.p_id=top.id WHERE re.o_sec_id=#{oSecId} AND re.type='RECHARGE' ORDER BY create_time DESC;
